title: Integrated indoor navigation system for aerial vehicle using visual odometry and artificial landmark matching
authors: X. He; Z. Cai; D. Huang; Y. Wang
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
